apps/web/components/features/auth/AuthUn.empty: The card is a fixed status message and renders no collection.
apps/web/components/features/auth/AuthUn.long-content: The card copy is fixed and takes no user text, so no content can overflow.
apps/web/components/features/auth/AuthUn.offline: The card makes no network request; it only links to the homepage or posts a form.
apps/web/components/features/auth/AuthUn.permission-denied: The card has no permission state; it is itself the unavailable state.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.empty: A row renders one release and owns no collection; the list empty state lives in ShellReleasesView.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.error: The row has no error state; sync problems are reported by the parent view, and the row only shows a syncing pulse.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.permission-denied: The row has no permission-gated state; plan limits surface as the smartLinkLockReason lock icon, covered by SmartLinkLocked.

apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoRe.empty: The demo renders one fixed release with real artwork and provider rows; it has no collection or empty state.
apps/web/components/features/demo/DemoRe.long-content: Every string is a fixed, verified demo constant (title, artist, listen links), so no variable-length content can reach the surface.
